cases.query: How many hours are required for a part-time internship?
cases.answer: Theo tai lieu duoc phep, doan lien quan la: a. Internship Request Form (IRF) completion by host site and approval by the College b. Must be an on-the-job learning experience. c. Registration within the first 3 weeks of the semester (except late adds and summer semester). Retroactive credit is not permitted. d. Have completed all required Foundation courses. e. For full-time internships: Minimum duration of each 7 weeks for Fall and Spring semesters and 6 weeks for summer semester. f. For part-time internships: Minimum duration of 240 hours each semester. g. Have 2.0 overall GPA, and all pre-requisites from supervising academic department. h. Student and Host Organization evaluations of learning objectives/outcomes plus a student reflection paper. Grading All internships are graded either on Pass/Fail or Letter Grade, depending on the course syllabus. The grading scheme should be communicated with students prior to the internship. Faculty mentoring, reporting and supervision Each student will be assigned with a Faculty mentor matching with the faculty expertise areas, to allow interaction between the faculty and the industry for research, executive education, and consultancy projects etc.
